sessions.name: A
sessions.reply:
I added a groceries row to `budget.csv`:

```
groceries,600,keep under 600; flag anything that would push it over
```

The CSV has no column for a cap versus a target, so I put 600 in `monthly_limit_usd`. If you want strictly under $600, change it to 599. I also put the flagging rule in the notes column.

I can't watch your spending on my own. If you tell me about a grocery expense or plan, I'll check it against the $600 and flag it if it would push you over.
